notes.title: Patch 1.10
notes.content:
Most of the feedback I've gotten is that the game is too difficult. 
Patch 1.10 focuses on balancing, especially making the game a bit easier.
Over 40 changes to Towers, Spells, Tiles and Enemies and most importantly, the initial money and money for clearing a wave will be increased in all levels.

Full patchnotes below:


[h1]General:[/h1]
Increased money on level start: +150$ in all level
Increased money after a wave is cleared +20$

[h1]Tower Changes:[/h1]
Increased Ballista Tower Damage 15 -> 16
Increased Tesla Tower Damage 30 -> 35
Decreased Tesla Tower Cost 120 -> 110
Increased Bolt Tower Range 6 -> 7
Increased Cold Tower Tier I Damage 12 -> 15
Increased Earthquake Tier I Damage 40 -> 42
Increased Earthquake Tower Range Tier I 4 -> 5, Tier II 5 -> 6, Tier III 6 -> 7
Increased Enchantment Tower Range Tier I 3 -> 4, Tier II 4 -> 5, Tier III 5 -> 6
Increased Fire Tower Tier Damage per Tick 16 -> 18
Increased Net Tower Atk Rate 3 -> 2.5

[h1]Spell Changes:[/h1]
Reduced Freeze Spell Cooldown 80 -> 60
Reduced Frenzy Spell Cooldown 80 -> 60
Reduced Meteor Spell Cooldown 120 -> 100
Reduced Tornado Spell 120 -> 100
Reduced Tornade Mana Cost 6 -> 5

[h1]Tile Changes:[/h1]
Increased Armory Range Mod -15% -> -12%
Increased TrapRoom Attack Speed Mod -25% -> -20%
Increased Stone (Basic Tile) Range Mod -30% -> -25%
Increased Stone (Basic Tile) Damage Mod -50% -> -40%

[h1]Enemy Changes:[/h1]
Reduced Bat base health: 60 -> 55
Reduced Bat base move speed 2.2 -> 2.1
Reduced BigBlob base move speed 1.9 -> 1.8
Reduced SmallBlob base move speed 2 -> 1.9
Reduced Golem & Golem Thrower base health 300 -> 280
Reduced Golem & Golem Thrower base move speed 1.1 -> 1
Reduced cost to destroy rocks form Golem Thrower 30 -> 20
Reduced Skeleton Mage base move speed 1.9 -> 1.8
Reduced Monster Plant base health: 150 -> 140
Reduced Necromant elemental armor 12 -> 10
Reduced Orc (Green, Blue, Red) base health 100 -> 90
Reduced Redwing base move speed 1.6 -> 1.4
Reduced Green Spider base move speed 2 -> 1.8
Reduced Spikey base health 100 -> 90
Reduced Spikey physical and elemental armor: 15 -> 13
Reduced Skeleton Warrior base health: 150 -> 130
Reduced Wasp base move speed 2 -> 1.8

[h1]Boss Changes:[/h1]
Reduced base health of all Bosses by ~10%
Reduced Golem Boss base move speed 1.1 -> 1.0
Reduced Necromant Boss elemental armor 12 -> 10
Reduced Skeleton Warrior Boss physical armor 8 -> 6 (matches the basic variant now)

notes.title: Patch 1.09
notes.content: Added setting to toggle VSync in main menu options.

notes.title: Patch 1.08
notes.content:
[h2]Difficulty[/h2]
- Reduced Physical Armor of Skeleton Warrior (8 -> 6)
  (That means Ballista Tower will do 2 damage to them instead of 0 when placing on a stone tile)
- Reduced difficulty of Level 01, 02, 03, 04 by increasing the start gold and the spawn time between each enemy

notes.title: Patch 1.07
notes.content:
[h2]Camera[/h2]
- Press V to switch to top down view
- maximum vertical rotation angle is clamped between -90 and 90 -> no more looping

notes.title: Patch 1.06
notes.content:
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed Champion Achievement (Level 09 didn't gave upgrade stars)
- Win screen volume is now related to SFX volume setting
- Monster Plant Boss Ability (Explosion) is now related to SFX volume setting
- Moving doors in level selection are now related to SFX volume setting
- Flying rocks from golems are now related to SFX volume setting

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.content:
[h2]Enemy[/h2]
- Fixed Necromant Boss sometimes invincible after being hexed

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]
- Monster Plant Boss can not spawn in wave 10 or 20 (it was too overpowered in early waves)
- Decreased Boss health at wave 10
- Increased enemy health scaling at wave 20 and higher

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.content:
[h2]Tower[/h2]
- Sniper tower changed: Chance to One-Shot -> Chance to do 2000 bonus damage

[h2]Enemy[/h2]
- Green Spider Boss: Capped health regeneration at 800 hp/s

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]
- Spawn 2 bosses on wave 40 and higher
- Instead of increasing the gold income per enemy by 1 every 10 waves it is set to 4 on all waves.
- Increased health scaling every 10 waves dramatically
- reduced spawn distance between spiders
- increased spawn distance between golems

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.content:
[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]
- Removed Chaos Tower reward selection (Tower was removed in last patch, but the reward was still in)
- Increased difficulty starting from wave 21
- Removed Money Tower (the tower is balanced for campaign mode when there are less than 10 waves, so it's was far to overpowered in endless mode)

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.content:
[h2]General[/h2]
- maximum money is set to 3000$
- added UI effect and sfx for Frenzy spell
- increased cannon tower lvl 3 upgrade cost

[h2]Endless Mode[/h2]
- reduced money per kill scaling
- increased enemy health scaling (even more at wave 21 and 41)
- score counter starts decreasing when the last enemy has spawned and not the first
- removed chaos tower

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
Decreased difficulty of Level 01 - Level 03:
 - Increased: Starting money from 300 to 400
 - Decreased enemy health on every wave

Known Issues:
- version number in main menu is 1.00 instead of 1.01 (will be fixed in the next patch)
- The score system of the endless mode will be reworked in the next patch, because at the later waves you can't kill the enemies fast enough to get a score for that wave
- The gold income per enemy will be reduced and the health of enemies increased
